assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and key-area polygons are provisional constraints derived from the official text and approximate areas; they are not official red lines.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, figures and drawings are intake and discussion results; the whole package must be recalculated when official polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenario cards, testing scenarios, landmarks, events and operating mechanisms are conceptual suggestions subject to data licensing, public review and human oversight.
assumptions.impact: No scenario is presented as approved operation, and no technology is presented as fully deployable.

assumptions.statement: The six global ecosystem cases are used as mechanism references from public official websites; no precise statistics, investment figures or policy commitments are claimed.
assumptions.impact: Case-derived mechanisms are design suggestions only and do not constitute verified facts about the project site.

assumptions.statement: Land-use partitioning, building footprints, road alignments, phasing and scenario nodes are AI-generated conceptual design layers inside the provisional boundary.
assumptions.impact: These layers support design discussion and self-check, not statutory planning conclusions.
